title: From Local Skills to Long-Horizon Web Tasks: Progressive Skill Exploration for LLM Web Agents
title_zh: 从局部技能到长程 Web 任务：面向 LLM Web 智能体的渐进式技能探索

paragraphs.en: 提出SCOPE框架,通过技能发现、编排与扩展实现由短及长的渐进探索,显著提升Web智能体性能。 Large language models (LLMs) are driving autonomous agents toward real-world environments, with the Web emerging as one of the most representative interaction scenarios. However, training Web agents with naive exploration remains challenging: successful trajectories are rare, and the sparse terminal rewards make it difficult for agents to obtain useful feedback from failed trajectories. Inspired by skill acquisition theory, we propose Skill-Composed Progressive Exploration (SCOPE), a short-to-long learning framework for long-horizon Web agents that decomposes complex task exploration into a gradual expansion process from local skills to complete task-solving capability. Specifically, SCOPE iteratively explores around local skills: Skill Discovery extracts reusable local skills and failure experiences from historical rollouts; Skill Orchestration composes discovered skills into high-level skill chains; and Skill Expansion leverages failure experiences aligned with the current skill chain to guide the agent toward exploring new subskills. Through this process, SCOPE progressively constructs task-completing skill chains across rollouts and internalizes them into the policy parameters through agentic on-policy distillation. Extensive experiments on WebArena, WebVoyager, and WebShop show that SCOPE consistently improves exploration dynamics and achieves 3.9% to 18.6% relative gains over the strongest baselines in each setting.
paragraphs.zh: 提出SCOPE框架，通过技能发现、编排与扩展实现由短及长的渐进探索，显著提升Web智能体性能。大规模语言模型（LLMs）正在推动自主智能体走向真实世界环境，而Web已成为最具代表性的交互场景之一。 然而，使用朴素探索训练Web智能体仍然具有挑战性：成功轨迹稀少，且稀疏的终端奖励使智能体难以从失败轨迹中获得有用的反馈。 受技能习得理论的启发，我们提出技能组合渐进探索（Skill-Composed Progressive Exploration, SCOPE），这是一个面向长程Web智能体的由短及长学习框架，它将复杂任务的探索分解为一个从局部技能到完整任务解决能力的渐进扩展过程。 具体而言，SCOPE围绕局部技能进行迭代探索：技能发现（Skill Discovery）从历史 rollout 中提取可复用的局部技能和失败经验；技能编排（Skill Orchestration）将发现的技能组合成高层技能链；技能扩展（Skill Expansion）利用与当前技能链相匹配的失败经验，引导智能体探索新的子技能。 通过这一过程，SCOPE在多次 rollout 中逐步构建完成任务所需的技能链，并通过智能体在策略线蒸馏（agentic on-policy distillation）将其内化到策略参数中。 在WebArena、WebVoyager和WebShop上的大量实验表明，SCOPE持续改善探索动态，并在每种设置中相对最强基线取得3.9%到18.6%的相对提升。
